mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declined over the prior month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate above 5.0% signals a deteriorating labor market that increases recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over the past month signals broad-based demand contraction, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS declined, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained economy (industrial production below 12-month moving average), a decline in industrial production signals worsening supply conditions that increase stagflation risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO < 12-month MA and INDPRO declined, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts over the past month (current value exceeding prior month) signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where HOUST rose, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading above 3.0% signals persistent inflation that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the past month signals severe labor market contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS declined and UNRATE rose, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-interest-rate regime (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), a decline in the federal funds rate signals a shift toward monetary easing, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and FEDFUNDS declined, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
